Conventionally, the mapping requires pixel-aligned LQ-HQ pairs. This requirement is unsatisfactory in practical scenarios because real scans at different times are never pixel-aligned. This paper addresses the challenge with a two-stage framework. The first stage generates pixel-aligned LQ-HQ datasets, and the second stage trains an enhancement model that improves LQ images. The first stage trains a cycle-consistent style-transfer model on unaligned real LQ-HQ pairs to learn a HQ-to-LQ model. Then, the model transforms real HQ images into pixel-aligned LQ images. Based on the dataset generated by the first stage, the second stage uses the Dual Degradation-Guided (DDG) Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) method to fine-tune an LQ-to-HQ model based on aligned pairs. In this stage, the model is based on the well known PiSA-SR framework but inserts a degradation-conditioned correction matrix. Experimental results on the USenhance2023 dataset show that the FID metric is improved by 16.7% over the strongest baseline while other metrics indicate that our enhanced outputs are well aligned with the real HQ distribution. The source code of our method is available at https://github.com/Jason0411202/DDG_LoRA.

</details>


### [399] [VideoPhysEdit: Physical Counterfactual Video Editing via Rigid-Body Physical Scene Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35134)
*Conghan Yue,Yuanjie Chen,Yue Han,Ya Gao,Yunyan Xiao,WeiYao Zhang,Zhineng Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出物理反事实视频编辑（PCVE）任务，并给出免训练流程 VideoPhysEdit 及配套基准 PCVE-RigidBench 与评测指标 Physical Edit Score。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频编辑方法多关注视觉后果（如阴影、遮挡变化），而物理后果（如编辑后运动与交互的变化）研究较少，且缺乏成对的反事实数据与专用评测指标。

Method: VideoPhysEdit 为免训练流程，面向刚体场景。通过新颖的物理场景重建方法显式进行物理推理，重建出能在仿真中复现观测运动与交互的场景，从而将物理编辑作为干预施加，并用生成的轨迹引导反事实视频生成。同时构建合成基准 PCVE-RigidBench（含配对源视频、反事实目标视频与物理真值），并提出 Physical Edit Score。

Result: VideoPhysEdit 的物理编辑准确率显著高于开源方法与商业模型，同时保持有竞争力的视觉保真度；Physical Edit Score 为 0.376，是对比方法中唯一为正的分数。真实视频的定性对比也表明其适用于真实场景，且能更好地刻画编辑引发的下游运动与交互。

Conclusion: 该工作定义并推进了 PCVE 任务，验证了通过显式物理重建与仿真干预来引导反事实视频生成的可行性与有效性。

Abstract: Video editing has advanced substantially in recent years, with methods increasingly accounting for the visual consequences of edits, such as changes to shadows and occlusions. However, the physical consequences of edits, including changes to subsequent motion and interactions, remain less explored. We formulate this problem as physical counterfactual video editing (PCVE), which aims to generate a counterfactual video depicting the resulting motion and interactions given a source video, a physical edit, and its execution frame. PCVE is challenging because it requires understanding scene physics and inferring the downstream motion and interactions induced by a physical intervention, while paired factual and counterfactual data and dedicated evaluation metrics are lacking. We introduce VideoPhysEdit, a new training-free pipeline for PCVE in rigid-body scenes. It makes physical reasoning explicit through a novel physical scene reconstruction method that recovers a scene reproducing the observed motion and interactions under simulation, enabling the pipeline to apply physical edits as interventions and use the resulting trajectories to guide counterfactual video generation. We further construct PCVE-RigidBench, a synthetic benchmark with paired source and counterfactual target videos and physical ground truth, and introduce the Physical Edit Score. VideoPhysEdit achieves substantially higher physical edit accuracy than open-source methods and commercial models while maintaining competitive visual fidelity. Its Physical Edit Score is 0.376, the only positive score among the compared methods. Qualitative comparisons on real videos further show that VideoPhysEdit applies to real-world scenes and better depicts the downstream motion and interactions induced by the edits than the compared methods. Code: https://github.com/Hammour-steak/VideoPhysEdit

</details>


### [400] [Timeline-Bench: Evaluating Agents on Realistic Video-Editing Tasks, from Raw Footage to Final Cut](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35143)
*Gunin Gupta,Nirmit Arora,Pavan Kalyan Tankala*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Timeline-Bench，一个含 56 个真实视频剪辑任务的基准，要求智能体将原始素材加工为成品视频。最强智能体仅解决 26.8% 的任务，平均为 14.0%，多数失败仅卡在质量测试上，反映其缺乏创作性剪辑能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI 智能体日益承担长周期专业工作，但现有评估很少要求交付完整的创作型成果，缺少对"成品级"视频剪辑能力的衡量标准。

Method: 构建 Timeline-Bench，包含 56 个真实视频剪辑任务，每项提供简报、源素材、容器与测试集；任务须通过全部测试才算解决。测试覆盖交付格式、内容与简报明确要求，并含一项基于 43 位剪辑师 2,582 次盲评校准的质量测试。评估 16 个由前沿模型与 Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode 等编码智能体框架组合的智能体。

Result: 最佳组合（Codex 中的 GPT-6 Astra 配合精选剪辑指导）仅解决 15/56 个任务（26.8%），平均解决率 14.0%；人类剪辑师在 83.5% 的判断中更偏好参考剪辑。771 次未解决运行中有 562 次仅未通过质量测试。

Conclusion: 现有智能体剪辑能力与专业水准差距显著；其通过静帧与文稿感知素材、只检查渲染缺陷而非打磨创作，导致创作质量瓶颈。任务、验证器与逐次运行结果已公开。

Abstract: AI agents increasingly carry out long-horizon professional work, but their evaluations rarely require a finished creative deliverable. To this end, we introduce Timeline-Bench, a benchmark of 56 real video-editing tasks, each asking an agent to turn raw production material into a finished video. Tasks range from selecting dialog takes and shaping interview footage into a story to cutting commercials from product shots, voiceovers and graphics. Every task provides a brief, source assets, a container and a set of tests. A task is resolved when the output passes every test. The tests check the delivery format, the content and the brief's explicit requirements, and include a quality test calibrated on 2,582 blind judgments by 43 video editors. We evaluate 16 agents that pair frontier models with coding-agent harnesses such as Codex, Claude Code and OpenCode. The best, GPT-6 Astra in Codex with curated editorial guidance, resolves only 15 of the 56 tasks (26.8%), and the average agent resolves 14.0%. Human editors prefer the reference edit in 83.5% of judgments. Most unresolved runs (562 of 771) fail only the quality test: agents perceive footage through stills and transcripts and check their renders for defects, not craft. We release the tasks, verifier and per-run results at https://timelinebench.tensortest.com.

</details>


### [401] [G$^3$-LoRA: Organizing Reward-Weighted Video Data with Gradient-Guided Grouped LoRA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35189)
*Jia Song,Wenhow Li,Lichen Bai,Bada Ye,Zeke Xie*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出G³-LoRA（梯度引导分组LoRA），通过探测奖励加权视频样本的类别级梯度、去除共享全局更新方向、按残差梯度兼容性对类别聚类、训练组专属LoRA专家并合并+在线蒸馏为单一适配器，解决异构奖励加权数据下共享LoRA训练导致能力平均化的问题，在Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B与CogVideoX-2B上验证有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 后训练基础视频模型时，通常假设所有数据类别产生兼容的更新，但当代币对应不同技能、领域或评估维度时该假设很脆弱。VBench2.0维度定义数据桶、外部多模态奖励管线分配样本权重，作者研究这一文本到视频后训练问题。

Method: 提出G³-LoRA：(1)探测奖励加权视频样本诱导的类别级梯度；(2)移除共享全局更新方向；(3)按残差梯度兼容性对类别聚类；(4)训练组专属LoRA专家；(5)通过权重合并+基于专家的在线蒸馏整合为单一适配器。理论动机是将奖励加权流匹配视为速度场回归——不兼容的奖励维度可能在重叠噪声潜空间区域偏好不同去噪方向，导致共享LoRA训练使能力被平均化。

Result: 在Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B-Diffusers上，合并后的分组适配器在匹配的VBench2.0评估中超过基座模型、联合奖励加权LoRA基线，以及用相同管线训练的随机、语义、原始梯度划分；独立评估者结论一致。在CogVideoX-2B上，分组避免了联合训练的负迁移。增益不均衡：合并压缩了最大专家增益，蒸馏恢复部分损失，相机运动和若干局部质量维度仍具挑战。

Conclusion: 梯度兼容性可作为组织奖励加权视频后训练数据的实用诊断工具。

Abstract: Post-training foundation video models on heterogeneous reward-weighted data usually assume that all data categories induce compatible updates. This assumption is fragile when categories correspond to different skills, domains, or evaluation dimensions. We study this problem in text-to-video post-training, where VBench2.0 dimensions define data buckets and an external multimodal reward pipeline assigns sample weights. We propose G$^3$-LoRA (Gradient-Guided Grouped LoRA), a data organization procedure that probes category-level gradients induced by reward-weighted video samples, removes the shared global update direction, clusters categories by residual gradient compatibility, trains group-specific LoRA experts, and consolidates them into one adapter by weight merging followed by on-policy distillation from the experts. We motivate this procedure by viewing reward-weighted flow matching as velocity-field regression: incompatible reward dimensions may prefer different denoising directions in overlapping noisy latent regions, causing shared LoRA training to average capabilities. On Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B-Diffusers, the merged grouped adapter improves the matched VBench2.0 evaluation over the base model, a joint reward-weighted LoRA baseline, and random, semantic, and raw-gradient partitions trained with the same pipeline; an independent evaluator agrees, and on CogVideoX-2B grouping avoids the negative transfer of joint training. The gain is not uniform: merging compresses the largest specialist gains, distillation recovers part of this loss, and camera motion and several local-quality dimensions remain challenging. Together, these results suggest that gradient compatibility can serve as a practical diagnostic for organizing reward-weighted video post-training data.

</details>


### [402] [CarveMix-RC: Addressing Rare-Class Imbalance Through Lesion-Aware Synthetic Augmentation for Brain Metastasis Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35195)
*Md Shibly Sadique,Md Fayaz Bin Hossen,Michael L. Evans,Walia Farzana,Asfaqur Rahman,Ahmed Temtam,Khan M. Iftekharuddin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出基于nnU-Net的框架，通过RC加权损失、解剖一致性增强、残差编码器和病灶感知后处理，有效提升治疗后脑转移瘤中罕见切除腔的分割性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 治疗后脑转移瘤的精准分割对治疗规划、纵向监测和疗效评估至关重要。BraTS-MET 2026 Task 1涉及四个解剖学不同的肿瘤子区域，其中切除腔（RC）分割因患病率低、术后外观异质性强及病灶级评估协议而尤为困难，常规分割网络在优化中倾向于优先处理主导肿瘤类别，导致RC分割性能不足。

Method: 提出基于nnU-Net的框架，包含四个互补组件：(i) RC加权Dice与交叉熵优化以缓解类别不平衡；(ii) 解剖一致的腔体增强以增加术后腔体外观多样性；(iii) 残差编码器架构以增强多尺度特征学习；(iv) 病灶感知形态学后处理以抑制假阳性腔体预测并保留解剖合理结构。

Result: 在BraTS-MET 2026 Task 1在线验证基准上评估，集成模型（残差编码器nnU-Net + nnU-Net + RC感知CarveMix）表现最佳，ET、TC、WT、RC的病灶级Dice分别为0.732、0.752、0.708、0.575，对应NSD为0.794、0.798、0.727、0.474。

Conclusion: 整合RC感知优化、解剖一致增强和病灶感知后处理可有效提升治疗后脑转移瘤中罕见切除腔的分割性能，为临床相关分割问题提供了有效策略。

Abstract: Accurate segmentation of post-treatment brain metastases is essential for treatment planning, longitudinal disease monitoring, and quantitative assessment of therapeutic response. The BraTS-MET 2026 Task 1 challenge introduces a clinically relevant segmentation problem involving four anatomically distinct tumor subregions: non-enhancing tumor core (NETC), surrounding non-enhancing FLAIR hyperintensity (SNFH), enhancing tumor (ET), and the resection cavity (RC). Among these, RC segmentation is particularly challenging because of its low prevalence, heterogeneous postoperative appearance, and lesion-wise evaluation protocol, leading conventional segmentation networks to prioritize dominant tumor classes during optimization. The proposed nnU-Net-based framework explicitly addresses RC segmentation through four complementary components: (i) RC-weighted Dice and Cross-Entropy optimization to alleviate class imbalance, (ii) anatomically consistent cavity augmentation to increase the diversity of postoperative cavity appearances, (iii) a residual encoder architecture for enhanced multi-scale feature learning, and (iv) lesion-aware morphological post-processing to suppress false-positive cavity predictions while preserving anatomically plausible structures. The framework is evaluated on the BraTS-MET 2026 Task 1 online validation benchmark. Among the evaluated configurations, the ensemble model (Residual Encoder nnU-Net + nnU-Net + RC-aware CarveMix) achieves the best performance, with lesion-wise Dice scores of 0.732, 0.752, 0.708, and 0.575 and corresponding NSD scores of 0.794, 0.798, 0.727, and 0.474 for ET, TC, WT, and RC, respectively. These experimental results show that integrating RC-aware optimization, anatomically consistent augmentation, and lesion-aware post-processing provides an effective strategy for improving rare resection cavity segmentation in post-treatment brain metastases.

</details>


### [403] [From UNI2-h to ConvNeXt-T: Lightweight Nuclei Instance Segmentation via Knowledge Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35203)
*Wenyan Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 将UNI2-h病理基础模型通过输出级知识蒸馏迁移到ConvNeXt-Tiny学生模型，实现高精度、实时的细胞核实例分割。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数字病理中高精度细胞核实例分割依赖大型ViT编码器，推理速度难以满足实时临床需求。

Method: 提出轻量化方案，将UNI2-h病理基础模型通过输出级知识蒸馏迁移到ConvNeXt-Tiny学生模型（Ours-T，34.7M参数，为教师的1/20）。

Result: Ours-T在PanNuke上mPQ达0.519（教师的98.8%），在MoNuSeg上零样本bPQ为0.668，推理速度634.3 img/s，1024²全分辨率分析仅需0.045 s（21.8倍加速）。实验还表明多尺度门控卷积（MALA）在ViT编码器下无增益。

Conclusion: 仅输出级蒸馏即可实现高效知识迁移，兼顾精度与实时性。

Abstract: Nuclei instance segmentation is a core task in digital pathology, yet high-accuracy models rely on large vision transformer (ViT) encoders whose inference speed cannot meet real-time clinical demands. We propose a lightweight scheme that distills the UNI2-h pathology foundation model into a ConvNeXt-Tiny student (Ours-T, 34.7M parameters, 1/20 of the teacher) via output-level knowledge distillation. Ours-T achieves an mPQ of 0.519 on PanNuke (98.8% of the teacher), a zero-shot bPQ of 0.668 on MoNuSeg, and an inference speed of 634.3 img/s, requiring only 0.045 s for full-resolution 1024^2 analysis (21.8x speedup). Experiments further show that multi-scale gated convolution (MALA) yields no gain under ViT encoders, and output-level distillation alone suffices for efficient knowledge transfer.

</details>


### [404] [Generative AI-Based Data Augmentation for Oral Lesion Classification: The PhotoMOCI Dataset and Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35226)
*Marco Parola,Mario G. C. A. Cimino,Sabrina Senatore*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出口腔癌影像数据集PhotoMOCI，并系统评测生成式数据增强策略，提出合成图像过滤器（SIF）以筛选高质量合成样本，显著提升分类性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 口腔癌摄影成像筛查前景广阔，但高质量标注数据稀缺，制约了深度学习模型的开发；同时生成式数据增强直接应用可能带来性能下降。

Method: 构建并发布PhotoMOCI数据集，用于口腔肿瘤学多诊断任务；开展基准研究，对比传统增强与生成式方法（GAN、扩散模型）；提出合成图像过滤器（SIF），基于合成代理分类器和合成图像检测器两个辅助模型筛选样本。

Result: 最佳SIF过滤方案在所有设置下均优于传统增强：在PhotoMOCI上ResNet50和ViT分别提升+1.73%和+2.35%，在KOCD上分别提升+2.38%和+2.08%。

Conclusion: 生成式数据增强直接应用可能降低性能，而结合样本真实性与类别判别特征的SIF筛选机制简单有效，可过滤混淆分类器的合成样本，提升下游表现。

Abstract: Early detection of oral cancer via photographic imaging presents a promising avenue for large-scale oral cavity screening. However, the development of robust deep learning models is frequently hampered by the scarcity of high-quality, annotated datasets. To address this limitation, a novel and well-curated resource, the Photographic Multi-purpose Oral Cancer Imaging (PhotoMOCI) dataset, is introduced for developing models across multiple diagnostic tasks in oral oncology. Then, a comprehensive benchmark study was conducted to investigate how various data augmentation strategies influence the performance of image classifiers. Our analysis spans different generative AI frameworks, evaluating the efficacy of traditional methods against advanced generative approaches, including Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) and Diffusion Models (DMs). Additionally, we propose the Synthetic Image Filter (SIF), a mechanism to select specific samples based on two auxiliary models: Synthetic Proxy Classifier to ensure samples are representative of the target class and Synthetic Image Detector to verify they appear realistic, thereby selecting only the high-utility images that contribute to improving downstream performance. Across the evaluated datasets and classifiers, the best SIF-filtered setup improves accuracy over traditional augmentation in all cases, with gains of +1.73% and +2.35% on PhotoMOCI and +2.38% and +2.08% on KOCD for ResNet50 and ViT, respectively. Our findings reveal that while the direct application of generative data augmentation may yield performance drops, the integration of SIF, considering (i) how synthetic data looks real and (ii) how it reflects the discriminative features of the belonging class, provides a simple yet effective mechanism to filter out synthetic samples that confuse the classifier during training.

</details>


### [405] [Token-Disentangled Latent Test-Time Scaling for Vision-Language Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35228)
*Hao-Xuan Ma,Yihao Liu,Yutao Sun,Yanting Miao,Mengyu Zhou,YiCheng Xiao,Long Chen,Zhenguo Li,Han-Jia Ye,Xiaoxi Jiang,Guanjun Jiang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Token-Disentangled Latent Test-Time Scaling框架，实现角色感知的隐状态细化，在视觉与推理基准上提升多模态大模型准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有隐空间测试时缩放方法对所有可编辑隐token施加单一标量奖励，忽略了多模态大模型中生成token角色不同——部分对视觉证据敏感，部分对应不确定的推理决策，全局更新会削弱效果。

Method: 从初始生成轨迹出发，优化一小段隐状态前缀；将感知侧的视觉反馈路由到图像敏感token，将推理反馈路由到高熵token；未被任一通路选中的token由锚点正则化约束。

Result: 在Qwen2.5-VL-7B与InternVL3.5-8B上，跨感知与推理基准，宏观准确率较CoT分别提升+2.57和+1.51，并在相同解码候选预算下优于强输出空间测试时缩放基线。

Conclusion: 角色感知的隐token细化优于全局标量奖励式隐空间测试时缩放，能有效结合视觉感知与推理反馈提升多模态推理性能，代码已开源。

Abstract: Latent test-time scaling improves reasoning by refining hidden states during inference, but existing methods typically apply a single scalar reward to all editable latent tokens. For multimodal large language models, this global update ignores that generated tokens play different roles: some are sensitive to visual evidence, while others correspond to uncertain reasoning decisions. We present Token-Disentangled Latent Test-Time Scaling, an inference-time framework that makes latent refinement token-role-aware. Starting from an initial generated trajectory, we optimize a short hidden-state prefix while routing perception-side visual feedback to image-sensitive tokens and reasoning feedback to high-entropy tokens. Tokens selected by neither route are constrained by an anchor regularizer. Across both perception and reasoning benchmarks on Qwen2.5-VL-7B and InternVL3.5-8B, our method lifts macro accuracy over CoT by +2.57 and +1.51 respectively, and outperforms strong output-space test-time scaling baselines under matched decoded-candidate budgets. Code is available at https://github.com/Qwen-Applications/TD-LTTS.

</details>


### [406] [Beyond Selection: Token Parameterization for Extreme Visual Token Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35232)
*Rui Zhong,Yu Li,Zheyu Yan,Cheng Zhuo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Braco轻量四步编码器，从token参数化视角重新审视视觉token压缩，兼顾可压缩性与可学习性，在23×–64×压缩下达到较优的精度-效率前沿，144×仍具竞争力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉token压缩方法在极端压缩预算下存在缺陷：token剪枝会破坏视觉定位，而可学习重采样器会增加参数量、注意力开销与训练复杂度。作者希望通过token参数化的新视角重新审视压缩问题。

Method: 将压缩分解为（i）基变换与结构化截断（保留子空间/可压缩性）和（ii）坐标组织（优化与跨模态对齐）两部分，并形式化为可压缩性与可学习性两个耦合目标函数。据此设计Braco四步编码器：变换基截断、与输入无关的基坐标嵌入、依赖预算的正交重参数化，以及来自轻量池化的可学习空间残差token。

Result: 在23×–64×压缩下形成有利的精度-效率前沿，144×下仍具竞争力，达到95.2%准确率，同时相较未压缩上界减少84.2%–86.7%的prefill FLOPs；对比已有方法，精度持平或提升，端到端加速最高约36%，压缩器延迟/FLOPs分别低16.6×/78.8×。

Conclusion: 通过token参数化视角统合基变换截断与坐标组织，Braco以轻量设计在极端压缩预算下实现了精度与效率的良好平衡，优于或匹配现有方法。

Abstract: Visual-token compression is effective for improving the efficiency of vision-language models, but under extreme compression budgets, token pruning can break visual grounding while learned resamplers increase parameter count, attention cost, and training complexity. We revisit compression through a token parameterization lens, separating (i) basis transformation and structured truncation (retained subspace/compressibility) from (ii) coordinate organization (optimization and cross-modal alignment). This view yields two coupled objectives, compressibility and learnability, which we formalize as unified functionals. Guided by these objectives, we design Braco, a lightweight four-step coder that combines transform-basis truncation, input-independent basis-coordinate embeddings, budget-dependent orthogonal re-parameterization, and learned spatial residual tokens from lightweight pooling. Experiments show that Braco forms the favorable empirical accuracy-efficiency frontier under $23\times$--$64\times$ compression and remains competitive at $144\times$, reaching 95.2% accuracy while reducing prefill FLOPs by 84.2%--86.7% relative to the uncompressed upper bound. Against prior methods, Braco matches or improves accuracy while achieving up to approximately 36% end-to-end speedup and using $16.6\times$/$78.8\times$ lower compressor latency/FLOPs.

</details>


### [407] [DrawingsDreamer: A Unified Multi-View Engineering Drawings Generation Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35242)
*Shurui Liu,Weide Chen,Changwang Yi,Ancong Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 DrawingsDreamer，一个由大语言模型驱动的多视角矢量工程图生成统一框架。通过将多视角工程图生成建模为序列任务，并采用层次化后缀分词与渐进式课程学习，实现了高几何保真度与语法准确率的条件及无条件生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自回归 SVG 生成模型主要面向艺术创作，难以满足工程图所需的严格几何保真度与跨视角空间对齐要求，且通常依赖栅格图像编码器。

Method: 提出统一的 LLM 驱动框架 DrawingsDreamer，将多视角工程图生成直接形式化为序列建模任务，去除栅格图像编码器；设计基于层次化后缀分词的简化表示，先建立局部几何坐标再分配语义边界；采用渐进式任务感知课程调度，使模型从局部结构修复过渡到宏观生成。

Result: 大量实验表明，该统一模型在多种条件与无条件生成任务中，于几何保真度和语法准确率两方面均取得良好表现。

Conclusion: DrawingsDreamer 为面向工业 CAD 的多视角矢量工程图生成提供了统一且有效的解决方案，验证了纯序列建模路径的可行性。

Abstract: Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) are essential for modern industrial Computer-Aided Design (CAD). However, existing autoregressive SVG generation models are predominantly tailored for artistic creation and struggle to maintain the rigorous geometric fidelity and cross-view spatial alignment required for engineering drawings. To bridge this gap, we introduce \textbf{DrawingsDreamer}, a unified Large Language Model (LLM)-driven framework for multi-view vector-based engineering drawings generation. By formulating the generation of multi-view engineering drawings purely as a sequence modeling task, we eliminate the need of raster image encoders. We propose a Streamlined Representation utilizing hierarchical postfix tokenization, which guides the model to establish local geometric coordinates before assigning semantic boundaries. Optimized via a progressive task-aware curriculum schedule, \textbf{DrawingsDreamer} effectively transitions from localized structural repair to macroscopic generation in a unified model. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our unified model achieves strong performance in both geometric fidelity and syntactic accuracy across diverse conditional and unconditional generation tasks.

</details>


### [408] [AnswerMap: Faithful Spatial Interpretability of VLMs from Answer Posteriors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35247)
*Mohamed Eltahir,Fardows Adam,Duaa M. Tahir,Lama Alamoudi,Sana Ammar,Atheer A. Alboloshi,Jory Albluey,Tanveer Hussain,Naeemullah Khan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出 AnswerMap——一种免训练、任务无关、黑盒的视觉理由图，由模型输出头构建，能够原生支持连续输出任务并验证其忠实性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 VLM 可解释性工具依赖文本理由（模态不匹配）或内部读取（出现过早、反映不了最终输出，且需白盒访问），因此需要一种能反映最终输出、无需白盒权限的视觉理由工具。

Method: 将图像切成 K 个行带和 K 个列带，分别与查询组成 yes/no 相关问题送入冻结模型；对行和列的 "yes" 后验取外积，得到查询条件的空间图。在其上定义固定读取器 R（如期望、最大值）即可原生导出位置等连续输出，避免依赖离散文本 token。

Result: 在四个模型、三种查询分布上验证：(a) 与模型自身生成点的一致性 AUC 为 0.85（注意力仅 0.38）；(b) 删除地图区域会翻转 53% 的正确答案（注意力仅 19%）。三种读取器还分别实现：无生成地标记幻觉物体、在模型自身定位失败时正确本地化、将最高质量区域作为裁剪反馈修复一半错误答案。

Conclusion: AnswerMap 为 VLM 可解释性提供了新视角，并通过其读取器为视觉任务提供了超越文本 token 的新输出接口。

Abstract: When a VLM answers a visual query, current interpretability tools rely on text rationales, which use a mismatched modality, or on internal read-outs, which originate too early to reflect the final output and require white-box access to the model. We introduce AnswerMap, a training-free, task-agnostic, black-box visual rationale constructed from the output head. The image is cut into K row and K column bands, each shown alone to the frozen model along with the query in the format of a yes/no relevance question. The outer product of the row and column ``yes'' posteriors gives the query-conditioned spatial map. Crucially, by defining a fixed read-out R (e.g., expectation, maximum) on top of AnswerMap, we can derive continuous outputs like location natively. This bypasses the reliance on discrete text tokens for continuous-output tasks and guarantees an image-dependent answer by construction. However, a rationale can be confabulated, so we validate AnswerMap across four models and three query distributions with two tests: (a) agreement with the model's own generated point and (b) deletion of the map's region. The map lands where the model points (AUC 0.85 against 0.38 for attention), and deleting its region flips 53% of correct answers (against 19% for attention's). Beyond establishing faithfulness, we demonstrate the map's task-agnostic utility through three distinct read-outs: its maximum flags hallucinated objects without generation, its expectation localizes correctly when the model's own pointing fails, and its top-mass region, fed back as a crop, fixes half of the model's wrong answers. AnswerMap thus offers a new lens on VLM interpretability and, through its read-outs, a new output interface for visual tasks beyond text tokens.

</details>


### [409] [Evaluating Hierarchy-Aware Deep Learning for the Recognition of Tironian Notes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35277)
*Yule Kang,Thomas Gorges,Janne van der Loop,Franziska Marske,Nikolaus Weichselbaumer,Tino Licht,Vincent Christlein*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究提罗符号（Tironian notes）的自动识别，比较扁平分类器（ResNet18、ConvNeXt、Swin、ViT）与基于层级结构的HD-CNN式粗到细模型及层级感知路由模型。结果表明层级结构的收益取决于是否进行域适应：在无适应条件下HD-CNN最佳（45.43% Top-1），而少样本适应后扁平分类最佳（82.09% Top-1）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 提罗符号被视为首个拉丁文速记系统，符号数量庞大、视觉高度相似，人工释读耗时，含此类符号的手稿难以被研究者利用。自动识别面临挑战：模型需区分细微的笔画形状与符号结构差异，而真实训练数据稀缺。此外，标准扁平分类器未显式利用相关符号间的视觉或结构关系，因此本文探究层级结构关系能否辅助自动识别。

Method: 使用Martin Hellmann的Supertextus Notarum Tironianarum（SNT），其中提供理想化符号形式与提罗符号的层级组织。将扁平分类器（ResNet18、ConvNeXt、Swin、ViT）与HD-CNN式粗到细模型、以及基于视觉类别清洗和相似度重聚类的层级感知路由模型进行比较。在手写样本与来自Vergilius Turonensis的手稿域样本上评估，分别在有/无有限少样本域适应的情况下测试。

Result: 在Vergilius Turonensis上，HD-CNN在无适应条件下取得最佳Top-1结果45.43%；扁平分类在少样本适应后达到最佳Top-1结果82.09%。扁平与层级模型的相对表现取决于是否进行适应。

Conclusion: 结果表明层级结构能够支持提罗符号识别，尤其在无适应条件下效果更明显。

Abstract: Tironian notes are generally regarded as the first Latin shorthand system and are notable for their large, fine-grained symbol inventory. Their high visual similarity and large class set make manual reading time-consuming, leaving manuscripts that contain Tironian notes inaccessible to many researchers. Automatic recognition is also challenging because models must distinguish subtle differences in stroke shape and sign structure while realistic training data remain scarce. However, standard flat classifiers do not explicitly use visual or structural relations between related signs. This paper investigates whether structural relationships between Tironian notes can support automatic recognition. We use the Supertextus Notarum Tironianarum (SNT) by Martin Hellmann, which provides idealized sign forms and a hierarchical organization of Tironian notes. We compare flat ResNet18, ConvNeXt, Shifted Window Transformer (Swin), and Vision Transformer (ViT) classifiers with Hierarchical Deep Convolutional Neural Network (HD-CNN)-style coarse-to-fine models and hierarchy-aware routing models based on visual class cleaning and similarity-based re-clustering. The models are evaluated on handwritten samples and manuscript-domain samples from Vergilius Turonensis, both with and without limited few-shot adaptation to the manuscript domain. The results show that the relative performance of flat and hierarchical models depends on adaptation. On Vergilius Turonensis, HD-CNN achieves the best non-adapted Top-1 result with 45.43%, while flat classification reaches the best Top-1 result after few-shot adaptation with 82.09%. Overall, the results indicate that hierarchical structure can support Tironian note recognition, especially under non-adapted conditions.

</details>


### [410] [Domain-adaptive Zero-Shot Image Enhancement via Locality-Constrained Diffusion Guidance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35289)
*Theresa Neubauer,Dimitrios Lenis,Astrid Berg,Maria Wimmer,Gaia Romana De Paolis,Philip Matthias Winter,David Major,Johannes Novotny,Ariharasudhan Muthusami,Katja Bühler*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LocDiff是一种局部性约束的引导方法，用于图像增强，作为预训练扩散模型的零样本扩展，在域适应过程中保留关键局部特征，实现真实感与保真度的更好权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无条件下图像生成性能优异，但要让扩散模型生成符合预期语义的图像，现有方法通过引导约束限制解空间。然而跨域图像增强面临两个需求难以平衡：目标域的真实感（照片级图像）与保留源域相关特征（如低质渲染图或艺术画作）。局部小变化可能彻底改变保真度，而其他区域的大变化可能无关紧要。

Method: 提出LocDiff，一种局部性约束的引导方法，作为预训练扩散模型的零样本扩展。通过只对关键局部特征施加约束予以保留，允许非关键区域不受约束，避免干扰相关区域的引导过程。在两个域偏移任务上评估：艺术画到照片的转换（完全零样本，保留画作中的人脸身份同时生成照片级细节）；低质胎儿超声渲染图增强（零样本推理加辅助先验对齐，人工添加高分辨率特征并生成照片级超声图，该目标域无真实分布）。

Result: 实验结果表明，与最先进方法相比，LocDiff实现了更优的真实感-保真度权衡，支持可控的跨域增强。

Conclusion: LocDiff通过局部性约束引导，在域适应中保留关键源域特征，同时保证目标域真实感，实现可控的跨域图像增强。

Abstract: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models have shown remarkable performance in unconditional image generation. In order to generate images with desired semantics, recent works have restricted the solution space by using guidance constraints in the diffusion sampling process.
  However, for image enhancement across different domains, these methods struggle to balance two main requirements: looking realistic in the target domain (photorealistic images) and preserving relevant features of the source domain, e.g., low-quality renderings or art paintings. Here, small local changes can alter the fidelity of the image completely, while large changes in other regions might be insignificant.
  We introduce LocDiff, a locality-constrained guidance method for image enhancement, which serves as a zero-shot extension to pre-trained diffusion models, ensuring the preservation of critical features during domain adaptation. In this way, we retain important local features, while allowing less critical regions to remain unconstrained and not interfere with the guidance process for relevant regions. We evaluate our method on two different domain-shift tasks: For art-to-photo translation, we apply the method in a fully zero-shot setting, preserving facial identity from paintings while generating photorealistic details. For enhancing low-quality fetal ultrasound renderings, we demonstrate zero-shot inference with auxiliary prior alignment. Here, the objective is to artificially add high-resolution characteristics and produce photorealistic ultrasound renderings, a target domain for which no ground truth distribution exists. Our experimental results demonstrate that LocDiff achieves favorable realism-faithfulness trade-offs compared to state-of-the-art methods, enabling controllable cross-domain enhancement.

</details>


### [411] [Scaffold Then Internalize: Representation Injection for Diffusion Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35292)
*Han Fu,Jiacheng Chen,Baoquan Zhao,Weidong Chen,Wei Liu,Qing Li,Xudong Mao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: REPI提出将预训练视觉编码器表示注入扩散Transformer参与去噪，通过“支架-内化”策略逐步内化表示，性能优于REPA且与之互补，训练加速超过43.5倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有REPA方法通过将扩散Transformer隐状态投影对齐到预训练编码器表示来加速训练，但仅将编码器表示作为外部对齐目标，未让其直接参与去噪过程。本文探索反向互补方向，让编码器表示注入扩散Transformer并主动参与去噪。

Method: 提出REPI训练框架，基于“支架-内化”策略：投影后的编码器表示最初作为临时支架，随后被扩散Transformer逐步内化，从而在去噪过程中发挥作用。

Result: REPI在多种骨干网络上优于REPA，且与REPA高度互补，两者结合相比单独使用均取得显著提升；仅用160K训练步，REPI+REPA即可匹配训练7M步的原始SiT，加速超过43.5倍。

Conclusion: 将编码器表示注入扩散Transformer并使其参与去噪是一种有效且与REPA互补的表示利用方式，可大幅加速扩散Transformer训练。

Abstract: Recent representation alignment (REPA) methods accelerate diffusion transformer training by aligning projections of the transformer's hidden states with representations from pretrained visual encoders. In this work, we explore a reverse and complementary direction to REPA: rather than projecting diffusion representations into the encoder's space, we inject encoder representations into the diffusion transformer, allowing them to actively participate in the denoising process. To this end, we introduce \textit{REPresentation Injection} (REPI), a training framework based on a scaffold-to-internalization strategy, in which projected encoder representations initially serve as a temporary scaffold and are then progressively internalized by the diffusion transformer. REPI outperforms REPA across a wide range of backbones and is highly complementary to it: combining the two yields substantial gains over either alone. Notably, with only 160K training steps, REPI + REPA matches vanilla SiT trained for 7M steps, a speedup of over $43.5\times$. Code will be available at https://jeneveuxpas.github.io/REPI

</details>


### [412] [Beyond Saying Less: Fine-Grained Alignment for Informative and Faithful Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35294)
*Xingming Long,Jie Zhang,Yuecong Min,Shiguang Shan,Xilin Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对大型视觉语言模型的物体幻觉问题，提出细粒度对齐框架：数据层面构建DOPA数据集，算法层面提出SCAPO子句级信用分配，并利用忠实描述作为辅助上下文迁移至判别任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线策略强化学习虽能直接针对模型当前失败模式，但缺乏细粒度奖励设计与分配时会陷入"少说少错"的捷径，即通过减少有效陈述来降低幻觉；同时稀疏标注导致有效物体陈述难以被验证和奖励，响应级共享优势也让局部幻觉损害同一响应中其他有效输出。

Method: 提出细粒度对齐框架，将数据层面的稠密奖励信号与算法层面的精确信用分配相结合。一是构建Dense Object Presence and Absence（DOPA）数据集，在扩展词表上详尽标注每个概念的确定性存在与缺失，提升在线rollout中可靠奖励信号的密度；二是提出Subsentence-level Credit Assignment for on-Policy Optimization（SCAPO），基于物体陈述为每个子句独立分配信用，精确强化忠实生成、惩罚幻觉；并将生成的忠实图像描述作为辅助上下文，把生成增益迁移到判别任务。

Result: 实验表明，该方法在生成任务中能产生信息丰富且忠实的描述，同时在判别式评估上取得明显的性能提升。

Conclusion: 通过数据级稠密奖励与算法级细粒度信用分配的耦合，可有效缓解在线策略优化中的"少说少错"捷径与响应级信用共享问题，在抑制物体幻觉的同时兼顾生成与判别任务的性能。

Abstract: Object hallucination remains a major challenge for large vision-language models. While off-policy preference optimization proves to be an effective solution, on-policy reinforcement learning provides a more promising direction as it directly targets a model's current failure modes. However, we find that without fine-grained reward formulation and allocation, on-policy optimization often falls into an easy shortcut: reducing hallucinations merely by saying less---making fewer valid claims. To comprehensively resolve this, we propose a fine-grained alignment framework that couples dense reward signals at the data level with precise credit assignment at the algorithmic level. Specifically, we first construct the Dense Object Presence and Absence (DOPA) dataset to address sparse annotations that prevent valid object claims from being verified and rewarded. DOPA exhaustively annotates the deterministic presence and absence of every concept across an expanded vocabulary, significantly increasing the density of reliable reward signals during on-policy rollouts. Second, we propose Subsentence-level Credit Assignment for on-Policy Optimization (SCAPO) to prevent response-level shared advantages from allowing local hallucinations to compromise all other valid outputs within the same response. By assigning credit to each subsentence independently based on its object claims, SCAPO can precisely reinforce faithful generations and penalize hallucinations. Furthermore, we leverage the resulting faithful image descriptions as auxiliary context to transfer generative gains to discriminative tasks. Experiments demonstrate that our method produces highly informative, faithful descriptions in generative tasks while yielding clear performance gains on discriminative evaluation.

</details>


### [413] [PIVOT: Pivot-Aware On Policy Self Distillation for Multi-Turn VLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35303)
*Jiazhou Zhou,Hu Zhou,Yucheng Chen,Jinyuan Qu,Ying-Cong Chen,Lei Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文揭示 OPSD/OPD 的性能提升主要来自枢轴步（pivot step）处的物理状态回滚，并提出 PIVOT 框架，将枢轴定位与状态恢复内化到 token 级参数更新中，在五个多轮 VLM 智能体任务上取得 0.90–0.92 的总体准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GRPO 等 RLVR 方法在多轮 VLM 智能体训练中存在均匀失败时的零梯度静默与粗粒度回合级信用分配问题；OPD/OPSD 虽能缓解稀疏奖励，但其机制未被充分理解，且其依赖的物理状态回滚在计算上不可行、在真实环境中难以实现。

Method: 通过五个多轮 VLM 智能体基准上的受控反事实回滚探针，定位性能增益来源为枢轴步回滚；提出 PIVOT 框架，将枢轴定位与状态恢复内化为 token 级参数更新：失败分析器（Analyzer）从视觉轨迹拼图与动作日志中非侵入式定位枢轴步并诊断失败模式，冻结的教师（Teacher）在该特权诊断上下文中对失败 token 重新打分，学生（Student）优化联合的 GRPO 与置信度门控 OPD 目标；测试时移除 Teacher 与分析器分支。

Result: 在认知网格谜题、3D 具身控制与导航、生成式推理等五个多轮 VLM 智能体任务上，PIVOT 在 Qwen2.5-VL-3B 上取得 0.90 总体准确率（较 SFT+GRPO 基线提升 8%，较此前 SOTA 提升 5%），在 Qwen3-VL-2B 上达到 0.92（较 SFT+GRPO 基线提升 12%）。

Conclusion: OPSD/OPD 的收益主要由枢轴步的物理状态回滚驱动，而 PIVOT 通过将枢轴定位与状态恢复内化到参数更新中，在不依赖环境回滚与测试时额外技能提示的前提下，实现了更强的多轮 VLM 智能体训练性能。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) via Group-Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is widely used for multi-turn VLM agent training, yet it suffers from zero-gradient silence on uniform failures and coarse episode-level credit assignment. While On-Policy Distillation (OPD) and On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) mitigate sparse rewards using hindsight information, their underlying mechanisms remain poorly understood. Through controlled counterfactual rollback probes across five multi-turn VLM agent benchmarks, we reveal that performance gains in OPSD/OPD are largely driven by physical state rollback at the pivot step, defined as the first unrecoverable action without remaining step budget. However, physical state rollbacks are computationally prohibitive and infeasible in real-world environments. To bridge this gap, we present Pivot-Aware Internalized Visual On-Policy Training (PIVOT), an RL framework that internalizes pivot localization and state restoration directly into token-level parameter updates, eliminating environment rollbacks during RL training and additional skill hints at test time. PIVOT unifies three functional roles within a single architecture: a failure Analyzer non-invasively localizes the pivot step and diagnoses failure modes from visual trajectory collages and action logs; a detached Teacher re-scores failed tokens under this privileged diagnostic context; and a Student optimizes joint GRPO and confidence-gated OPD objectives. At test time, both Teacher and Analyzer branches are stripped. Evaluated on five multi-turn VLM agent tasks across cognitive grid puzzles, 3D embodied control and navigation, and generative reasoning, PIVOT achieves 0.90 overall accuracy on Qwen2.5-VL-3B (+8% over SFT+GRPO baseline and +5% over previous SOTA) and scales to 0.92 on Qwen3-VL-2B (+12% over SFT+GRPO baseline).

</details>


### [414] [RoGSW4RLD: Feed-Forward 4D Gaussian Lifting for Robot World Model Rollouts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35311)
*Jin Hyun Kim,Min Young Kim,Soohwan Song,Daekyum Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出前馈框架 RoGSW4RLD，将多相机机器人 rollout 提升为统一、可随时间查询的度量 4D 高斯场，实现跨视角一致的视频世界模型空间化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有动作条件视频世界模型只输出分散的视频集合，而非可跨视角与时间查询的共享度量场景；独立重建并合并各相机流无法保证跨视角一致性，对移动机载相机与固定外部视角的组合尤为不利。

Method: RoGSW4RLD 为前馈框架，直接重建世界模型生成的视觉未来而非学习单独几何转移模型。采用两阶段架构：第一阶段融合跨视角证据与机器人关节几何和运动学，联合构建度量 4D 场；第二阶段在严格保持初始时间位移的前提下细化几何与外观。

Result: 在 256 个留出 DROID 片段上，相比逐相机重建加标定合并，新视角 PSNR 提升 2.15 dB，深度 AbsRel 降低 47%，机器人位移误差降低 61%；在动作条件 Cosmos 3 rollout 上同样获得稳健提升。

Conclusion: 预测的视频未来可被成功转化为一致、可空间查询的 4D 度量表示，验证了统一 4D 高斯场在多相机机器人世界模型空间化中的有效性。

Abstract: Action-conditioned video world models predict future robot interactions from multiple cameras, yet their outputs remain disparate video collections rather than a shared metric scene queryable across viewpoints and time. While existing 4D reconstruction methods offer a path to spatialize these predictions, independently reconstructing and merging each camera stream fails to enforce cross-view consistency. This limitation is particularly detrimental when combining moving robot-mounted cameras with fixed external views. To address this, we introduce RoGSW4RLD, a feed-forward framework that lifts synchronized multi-camera rollouts into a unified, time-queryable metric 4D Gaussian field. Rather than learning a separate geometric transition model, RoGSW4RLD directly reconstructs the visual future generated by existing world models. Its core innovation is a two-stage architecture: Stage 1 jointly forms the metric 4D field by fusing cross-view evidence with robot-specific articulated geometry and kinematics, while Stage 2 refines the field's geometry and appearance while strictly preserving the initial temporal displacements. Evaluated on 256 held-out DROID episodes, RoGSW4RLD significantly outperforms camera-wise reconstruction with calibrated merging, improving novel-view PSNR by 2.15 dB, reducing depth AbsRel by 47%, and lowering robot displacement error by 61%. These robust gains extend to action-conditioned Cosmos 3 rollouts, demonstrating that predicted video futures can be successfully translated into consistent, spatially queryable 4D metric representations.

</details>


### [415] [Generative Uncertainty as a Self-supervised Signal for Semantic Similarity Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35341)
*Enrico Pallotta,Sina Raoufi,Lars Doorenbos,Gianni Franchi,Juergen Gall*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种自监督方法，利用文生视频扩散模型的生成不确定性，在无需人工标注的情况下学习视频语义相似度，通过掩码筛选稳定语义特征，在三个任务上超越原始预训练特征与基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频语义相似度的定义与标注因复杂的时空特性而极为困难和昂贵，现有方法依赖人工标注，成本高且难以规模化。作者希望借助生成模型的固有行为，实现无需标注的相似度学习。

Method: 观察到T2V扩散模型对熟悉概念生成结果一致、对专门概念则方差与不确定性高。基于此，利用纯生成数据在VideoMAE、V-JEPA等预训练表示上学习一个掩码，保留在通用概念多次生成中保持一致的语义特征，丢弃与生成噪声或不确定性相关的特征，从而得到稳定的特征子空间。

Result: 在三个关键任务（如OOD检测、视频检索等）上的实验表明，学到的特征子空间一致优于原始预训练特征以及基线特征选择方法。

Conclusion: 生成不确定性可作为自监督信号，用于无标注地提取视频语义相似特征，为视频相似度学习提供了一种有效且可扩展的新范式。

Abstract: Evaluating semantic similarity between videos is a fundamental challenge in computer vision, essential for tasks ranging from out-of-distribution (OOD) detection to video retrieval. However, defining and labeling video similarity is notoriously difficult and expensive due to the complex spatio-temporal nature. In this paper, we propose a novel self-supervised approach that leverages generative uncertainty from text-to-video (T2V) diffusion models to learn semantic similarity without human annotations. Our method is based on the observation that T2V models produce consistent outputs for familiar concepts but exhibit high variance and uncertainty when prompted with specialized concepts. We utilize this behavior to identify stable semantic features within existing pretrained representations, such as VideoMAE and V-JEPA. Specifically, we learn a mask over these embeddings using purely generated data, encouraging the model to retain features that remain consistent across generations of general concepts while discarding those associated with generative noise or uncertainty. Experimental results across three key tasks demonstrate that our learned feature subspaces consistently outperform original pretrained features and baseline feature selection methods.

</details>


### [416] [Ego-Forge: Text and Geometric-Attention Free Exo-to-Egocentric Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35368)
*Mohammad Mahdi,Luc Van Gool,Danda Pani Paudel*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Ego-Forge：首个无字幕、无偏置的第三人称到第一人称视频生成框架，性能SOTA且泛化性更强。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有外中心到自我中心视频生成方法存在局限：或需额外输入（如真实初始自我中心帧、多视角同步），或仅限特定类别；EgoX虽有跨场景泛化能力，但推理时需人工提供字幕，且几何引导注意力偏置计算开销大、易传播重建误差并压制文本与视觉上下文。

Method: 提出Ego-Forge框架：引入动态字幕（Dynamic Captioning），从模型隐状态直接生成条件token并适配扩散时间步与网络深度，取代外部文本条件；训练规模扩大一个数量级并使用所有可用的外中心视角，使模型隐式学习跨视角对应关系，从而消除几何引导注意力，仅需轻量深度先验。

Result: 在Ego-Exo4D上达到SOTA性能，端到端运行更快，推理时无需外部标注，并可泛化到真实野外场景，包括过度依赖几何导致外观推理失败的情况。

Conclusion: Ego-Forge验证了无字幕、无几何偏置的跨视角生成范式有效性，模型与源码将公开。

Abstract: Exo-to-egocentric video generation aims to synthesize what a person sees from their own viewpoint given third-person footage and a target head trajectory. The task requires transferring appearance and semantics across large viewpoint changes while hallucinating content never observed by the exocentric camera. Existing approaches either impose additional input requirements, such as a ground-truth initial egocentric frame or multiple synchronized exocentric views, or remain limited to category-specific settings. EgoX is the first to address cross-activity and in-the-wild generalization, but requires a human-provided caption of the non-existent egocentric view at inference and introduces a computationally expensive geometry-guided attention bias that can propagate reconstruction errors and suppress textual and visual context. We therefore propose \textbf{Ego-Forge}, a caption-free and bias-free framework for exo-to-egocentric generation. It introduces \textit{Dynamic Captioning}, which derives conditioning tokens directly from the model's hidden states and adapts them to the diffusion timestep and network depth, replacing external text conditioning. By scaling training by an order of magnitude and using all available exocentric viewpoints, Ego-Forge learns cross-view correspondence implicitly and eliminates the need for geometry-guided attention, requiring only a lightweight depth prior. Ego-Forge achieves state-of-the-art performance on Ego-Exo4D, runs faster end-to-end, requires no external annotation at inference, and generalizes to in-the-wild scenes, including cases where over-reliance on geometry blocks appearance inference. Our model and source code will be made publicly available.

</details>


### [417] [Rethinking Visual Token Compression for Video Large Language Models: A Simple Yet Strong Baseline](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35394)
*Xiao Zhang,Wang Zeng,Sheng Jin,Wentao Liu,Chen Qian,Shichao Kan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SimpleCluster，一种无需训练的视频token压缩基线，通过位置感知的跨帧聚类并取均值表示，在多个基准和Video LLM上达到与先进方法相当甚至更优的效果，尤其在极低保留率下鲁棒性强。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频大语言模型因长视频产生大量视觉token，导致推理效率受限；现有压缩方法日益复杂，因此作者想探究：仅靠保留视觉表示中已编码的结构，能获得多少压缩性能。

Method: SimpleCluster在视觉特征空间中进行位置感知的跨帧聚类，并用每个聚类原始视觉特征的均值作为代表，整个过程无需训练。

Result: 在四个视频理解基准和三个代表性Video LLM上，SimpleCluster在广泛token保留率范围内取得与近期压缩方法相当或更优的性能，在极低保留率（如1%）下尤为鲁棒。分析显示，更强的下游性能与更好地保留原始视觉特征分布（尤其是全局覆盖）一致相关。

Conclusion: 特征空间保持是token预算高度受限时视频token压缩的重要考量，简单方法即可提供强基线。代码已开源。

Abstract: Video Large Language Models (Video LLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in video understanding, but their inference efficiency is constrained by the large number of visual tokens produced by long videos. Recent video token compression methods increasingly introduce sophisticated strategies for token selection, pruning, and merging. This raises a fundamental question: how much of compression performance can be obtained by simply preserving the structure encoded in the visual representations? We investigate this question with SimpleCluster, a simple and training-free baseline that performs position-aware cross-frame clustering in the visual feature space and represents each cluster using the mean of its original visual features. Extensive experiments across four video understanding benchmarks and three representative Video LLMs show that SimpleCluster achieves competitive or superior performance over recent compression methods across a wide range of token retention ratios, with particularly strong robustness under extremely low retention rates (e.g., 1%). To understand this behavior, we analyze the feature space preserved by different compression methods in terms of local approximation fidelity and global coverage. The results show that stronger downstream performance is consistently associated with better preservation of the original visual feature distribution, especially its global coverage. These findings highlight feature-space preservation as an important consideration for video token compression under highly constrained token budgets. Our code is available at https://github.com/xiaozhang79/SimpleCluster.

</details>


### [418] [Reduce, Then Encode: Multiscale Volumetric Reduction for 2D Foundation Models in Brain MRI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35405)
*Dexuan Ding,Yuankai Qi,Bogong Wang,Luping Zhou,Amin Beheshti*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Multiscale Volumetric Reduction (MVR)，一种"先降维再编码"的方法，将3D脑部sMRI体积沿解剖视图压缩为少量2D分量，再用冻结的2D基础模型编码，用于线性探测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 2D预训练基础模型在脑结构MRI上比专用3D预训练更实用，但2D编码器与3D体积输入之间存在维度不匹配。现有方法通常独立编码各切片再整合特征，效果受限。

Method: MVR在编码前将每个解剖视图的D个切片压缩为M<<D个互补2D分量：由原始穿平面强度导出的非中心PCA基分量，加上由多尺度空间描述子构造的残差细节分量。该降维在训练体积上估计，无需诊断标签或梯度优化，且此后固定不变。各分量由共享的冻结2D基础模型独立处理，拼接后进行线性探测。

Result: 在冻结编码器设定下，MVR在ADNI、OASIS和ABIDE上相对所评估的2D-to-3D适配方法及简单输入降维基线取得较强的整体性能，并从ADNI到AIBL表现出良好的泛化能力。

Conclusion: MVR为2D基础模型应用于3D脑部sMRI提供了一种无需训练、无需标签的高效桥接方案，兼顾性能与跨数据集泛化。

Abstract: Pretrained 2D foundation models offer a practical alternative to dedicated 3D pretraining for brain structural magnetic resonance imaging (sMRI), but their use on volumetric data requires bridging the mismatch between a 2D encoder and a 3D volume input. Existing methods typically encode slices independently and integrate their features afterwards. We introduce Multiscale Volumetric Reduction (MVR), a reduce-then-encode approach that compresses each anatomical view from (D) slices into (M << D) complementary 2D components before foundation-model encoding. MVR combines an uncentered-PCA base component derived from the original through-plane intensities with residual detail components constructed from multiscale spatial descriptors. The reduction is estimated from the training volumes without diagnostic labels or gradient-based optimization and remains fixed thereafter. The resulting components are independently processed by a shared frozen 2D foundation model and concatenated for linear probing. Under this frozen-encoder setting, MVR achieves strong overall performance across ADNI, OASIS, and ABIDE relative to the evaluated 2D-to-3D adaptation methods and simple input-reduction baselines, while also generalizing strongly from ADNI to AIBL.

</details>


### [419] [BiMoGen: Bidirectional Motion-Text Generation via Unified Masked Discrete Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35407)
*Wanjiang Weng,Yongliang Wu,Xiaofeng Tan,Xingyu Zhu,Wenbo Zhu,Hongsong Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出BiMoGen，一个基于掩码离散扩散的双向运动-文本统一生成框架，通过解耦单模态与跨模态训练及生成感知自校正缓解误差累积，在HumanML3D和KIT-ML上取得有竞争力的结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本到动作生成与动作到文本描述共享同一运动-文本对应关系，但现有统一方法多依赖自回归建模，强加固定生成顺序，难以适配语言与动作之间的双向依赖，早期预测误差会作为固定上下文持续存在，损害时间连贯性与跨模态一致性。掩码离散扩散通过迭代双向预测建模序列，可天然缓解该问题。

Method: 提出BiMoGen统一掩码离散扩散框架。设计解耦的单模态与跨模态训练：先用掩码预训练在成对运动-文本序列上建立跨模态对应，再用监督微调专门化双向生成。针对掩码扩散在训练时使用干净真值上下文、推理时遇到自生成错误上下文导致的误差传播，引入生成感知自校正，在训练中让模型接触自身预测，并在采样早期步骤应用校正以修正不可靠的已提交token。

Result: 在HumanML3D与KIT-ML数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法在文本到动作生成和动作到文本描述两个任务上均达到有竞争力的性能，验证了两阶段训练与自校正设计的有效性。

Conclusion: BiMoGen通过掩码离散扩散实现双向运动-文本建模，配合解耦训练与生成感知自校正，有效缓解自回归顺序约束与掩码扩散误差传播问题，为统一的双向跨模态生成提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Text-to-motion generation and motion-to-text captioning are two fundamental tasks in human motion modeling, both grounded in the same underlying motion-text correspondence. Existing unified approaches mostly rely on autoregressive modeling, which imposes a fixed generation order and is therefore poorly suited to the bidirectional dependencies between language and motion, allowing early prediction errors to persist as fixed context and degrade both temporal coherence and cross-modal consistency. Masked discrete diffusion, which models sequences through iterative bidirectional prediction, offers a natural remedy. We therefore propose BiMoGen (Bidirectional Motion-text Generation), a unified masked discrete diffusion framework for bidirectional motion-text modeling. To stabilize training, we design Decoupled Uni- and Cross-Modal Training, in which masked pretraining first establishes cross-modal correspondence on paired motion-text sequences, after which supervised fine-tuning specializes the model for bidirectional generation. Masked diffusion nonetheless introduces its own source of error, as the model is trained on clean ground-truth context yet encounters self-generated and potentially erroneous context at inference, with errors committed under heavily masked states propagating through subsequent steps. We further introduce Generation-Aware Self-Correction that exposes the model to its own predictions during training and applies correction passes at early sampling steps to revise unreliably committed tokens. Extensive experiments on HumanML3D and KIT-ML demonstrate competitive performance on both tasks, validating the effectiveness of the proposed two-stage training and self-correction designs. The project page is available at https://wengwanjiang.github.io/BiMoGen-Page.

</details>


### [420] [Spectral Super-Resolution using Spatial-Spectral Residual Operator Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35410)
*Seokhyun Chin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SSRON，将光谱超分辨率任务形式化为算子学习问题，用深度算子网络学习从降采样光谱到连续光谱的函数到函数映射，将Sentinel-2A类多光谱影像超分辨为EMIT影像。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多光谱卫星影像的光谱超分辨率能以较低成本获得高时空分辨率的高光谱卫星影像，显著提升高光谱遥感的适用性。但该任务本质上是病态问题，因此适合采用深度学习方法求解。

Method: 将光谱超分辨率任务建模为算子学习问题，提出SSRON——一种深度算子网络，学习从降采样光谱到连续光谱的函数到函数映射；模型训练目标是将Sentinel-2A类多光谱影像超分辨为EMIT影像。

Result: 与基线模型相比，SSRON在所有指标上均取得更优表现；模型还展现出零样本光谱超分辨率能力，可预测训练中未见过的波段；其连续输出形式表明有潜力在比原生传感器更细的波长间隔上估计光谱。

Conclusion: 结果表明SSRON具有应用潜力，并确立了算子学习作为光谱超分辨率一个有前景的研究方向。

Abstract: Spectral super-resolution of multispectral satellite images can enable high temporal- and spatial-resolution hyperspectral satellite imagery at a modest cost, significantly increasing the applicability of hyperspectral remote sensing. This task is inherently ill-posed, making it well-suited for deep learning-based methods. In this study, the spectral super-resolution task is framed as an operator learning problem, and SSRON is proposed as a Deep Operator Network that effectively learns function-to-function mappings from downsampled spectra to continuous spectra. The model is trained to super-resolve Sentinel-2A-like multispectral imagery to EMIT images. Compared to baseline models, SSRON achieves superior performance across all metrics. The model also demonstrates zero-shot spectral super-resolution capability by predicting bands unseen during training. Furthermore, its continuous-output formulation suggests the potential to estimate spectra at finer wavelength intervals than the native sensor. These results suggest the potential of SSRON and establishes operator learning as a promising direction for spectral super-resolution.

</details>


### [421] [When Should the Count Change? Learning State Maintenance for Causal Video Counting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35416)
*Pengyiang Liu,Dongyue Lyu,Junbo Niu,Zhongyue Shi,Jiahao Xie,Si Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出StaMina方法，通过状态条件更新维护计数状态，在连续视频计数任务中区分新观测与新对象/已完成事件，并在SVCBench上验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续视频计数需要区分新的观测、新的对象或已完成的事件。现有方法在维护持久计数状态（可见性、身份持续、已完成事件记录）方面存在不足，难以适应流式视频中的状态更新需求。

Method: StaMina通过状态条件化的更新学习维护计数状态：1）循环视觉上下文支持识别；2）学习的转移维护可见性、持久身份与已完成事件记录；3）可微循环在计数端点约束的合法路径上训练事件转移；4）可见性与关联目标训练对象分支；5）多源流水线组织39.8K空间查询与互补事件标注为计数轨迹。

Result: 在SVCBench上评估计数适应能力（部分视频重叠与留出链接标注组）。在前缀重放（Full）与持续流式（Stream）下，4B和8B模型分别达到41.9/36.4和44.9/38.2的高斯精度准确率。8B模型在同一查询上比Counting-SFT提升10.9/3.2个点。匹配图比较隔离了相位条件与轨迹监督作用。

Conclusion: StaMina通过状态维护与状态条件更新有效实现了连续视频计数，在SVCBench的在线视频基准与计数条件决策任务中表现优异，验证了训练目标与硬决策的评估价值。

Abstract: Continuous video counting requires distinguishing new observations from new objects or completed events. We introduce StaMina (State Maintenance), which learns to maintain counting state through state-conditioned updates. Recurrent visual context supports recognition; learned transitions maintain visibility, persistent identities, and completed-event records. A differentiable recurrence trains event transitions over legal paths constrained by count endpoints; visibility and association objectives train the object branch. A multi-source pipeline organizes 39.8K spatial queries and complementary event annotations into counting trajectories. On SVCBench, we evaluate counting adaptation with partial video overlap and held-out groups of linked annotations. Under prefix replay (Full) and persistent streaming (Stream), 4B and 8B models reach 41.9/36.4 and 44.9/38.2 Gaussian Precision Accuracy, respectively. The 8B model gains 10.9/3.2 points over Counting-SFT on the same queries. Matched-graph comparisons isolate phase conditioning and trajectory supervision, assessing training objectives alongside hard decisions. Online video benchmarks and count-conditioned decisions assess online understanding and task eligibility. Project Page: https://PLACEHOLDER.github.io/StaMina/

</details>


### [422] [Automated Species Identification in Camera Trap Images for Wildlife Conservation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35420)
*Nowshin Amin,Nafisa Tabassum Oyshi,Tahmid Abrar Zidan,Miftaun Noor,Md. Abrar Rahman Shafin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一个端到端野生动物保护框架，结合Swin-BiFPN主干与Faster R-CNN检测网络，并引入基于LLaVA v1.5(13B)的视觉语义提取模块，提升低对比度陷阱图像与小动物的检测精度，并实现零样本检测能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 野生动物保护需求日益迫切，但现有深度学习物种识别模型在低对比度陷阱图像中检测小动物时特征提取能力有限，效果不佳，亟需更强的检测与语义理解能力。

Method: 在Faster R-CNN检测网络中集成Swin-BiFPN主干以增强自注意力特征提取；同时构建由LLaVA v1.5(13B)多模态大语言模型驱动的视觉语义提取模块。MLLM评估采用传统NLP指标（精确率、召回率、F1、SBERT相似度）及基于LLM的评判者（GPT-4.1与GROK 3.0）对五种MLLM进行主观打分。

Result: 检测框架在困难陷阱图像上表现稳定且泛化性强，提升了低对比度图像与小动物的检测精度；视觉语义提取模块实现零样本检测，并能提供动物行为的洞察与涌现线索；模型在视觉描述生成上表现强劲。

Conclusion: 该框架有效改善了低对比度陷阱图像与小动物的检测精度，并借助MLLM实现零样本检测，为野生动物保护工作提供了有力支持。

Abstract: Wildlife conservation involves protecting, preserving, and managing wildlife species and their habitats. With today's rapid pace of human development, climate change, and other unsustainable practices, the need for wildlife conservation has heightened. Despite significant progress in species identification using deep-learning models, significant challenges still remain in effectively detecting small animals in low-contrast trap images due to limited feature extraction capabilities. This thesis presents a novel end-to-end framework integrating a self-attention mechanism to address these limitations. The proposed architecture involves a Swin-BiFPN backbone integrated in a Faster RCNN detection network, coupled with a visual semantic extraction module driven by the LLaVA v1.5 (13B) multimodal large language model. The detection framework, capable of extracting crucial features in challenging trap images, demonstrates consistently high results and robust generalization capabilities. Furthermore, the visual semantic extraction module provides zero-shot detection capability, as well as providing valuable insights and emergent cues of the animal's behavior, further supporting the conservation effort. The MLLM evaluation was conducted using both traditional NLP metrics (precision, recall, F1, and SBERT similarity) and subjective scoring by LLM-based judges (GPT-4.1 and GROK 3.0), across five MLLMs, demonstrating the model's strong performance in visual description generation. The proposed framework improves detection accuracy across low-contrast trap images and small animals while also demonstrating zero-shot detection capability leveraging the MLLM.

</details>


### [423] [DiMoP: Diffusion-Driven Motion Representation Learning With Frame-Level Pseudo-Classification for Skeleton-Based Action Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35444)
*Shanaka Ramesh Gunasekara,Wanqing Li,Nikalal Kaldera,Philip Ogunbona,Jack Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出DiMoP，一种结合掩码与扩散机制的骨架动作表示学习方法，并引入帧级伪分类，显式学习关节运动分布而非回归确定性坐标，在多个数据集上取得最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 鲁棒的骨架动作识别需要能捕捉从微弱、中等到强烈等广泛范围运动的表示，但现有方法往往只关注强烈运动，忽略了运动分布的完整谱系。

Method: DiMoP通过渐进噪声扩散被掩码的关节，并在可见关节条件下进行去噪，实现对弱、中、强动态的统一学习；同时提出伪帧分类器，无需人工标注即可学习序列一致且时间连贯的伪标签，从而在生成式扩散学习中融入判别能力，形成联合生成与判别的运动建模机制。

Result: DiMoP在NTU RGB+D 60/120和PKUMMD数据集上均达到最先进性能，在NTU RGB+D 120的跨被试协议下较以往工作提升1.1个百分点。

Conclusion: DiMoP通过掩码与扩散驱动的运动表示学习结合帧级伪分类，为关节生成与判别式运动建模提供了有原则的机制，并验证了其在骨架动作识别任务上的有效性与优越性。

Abstract: Robust skeleton-based action recognition requires representations that capture a wide spectrum of motions, from subtle to moderate and strong ones. Existing methods often focus on strong motions. This paper introduces DiMoP, a masking- and diffusion-driven motion representation learning method with frame-level pseudo-classification to explicitly learn the distribution of joint motions rather than regressing deterministic coordinates, as existing methods often do. By diffusing masked joints with progressive noise and denoising them conditioned on visible joints, DiMoP learns through controllable noising and denoising processes, enabling uniform learning of weak, moderate, and strong dynamics. To enable the masking-based generative diffusion learning with a discriminative capability, a pseudo-frame classifier is proposed that enforces the learning towards sequence-consistent and temporally coherent pseudo-labels without manual annotations. Together, these strategies provide a principled mechanism for joint generative and discriminative motion modeling. DiMoP achieves state-of-the-art performance across NTU RGB+D 60/120, and PKUMMD, including a 1.1 percentage point gain over prior works on NTU RGB+D 120 with the cross-subject protocol.

</details>


### [424] [From internal representations to model improvement through prediction errors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35449)
*Yushi Nakaya,Kenichi Higuchi,Shuichi Ishida*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需候选图像标签的数据选择方法：将目标模型内部特征与其预测误差及误差对性能的预期影响相关联，从而选出最有价值的标注图像。在目标检测任务上，该方法多数条件下优于仅基于特征稀有度的选择，并在长时间重训练设置下排名第一。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标注预算有限时，选择哪些图像进行标注直接影响模型提升幅度。已有方法依赖外部模型特征或视觉语言模型生成的场景描述，但这些信号无法直接反映被改进模型自身的变化；而目标模型内部特征会随训练而变化，是自然的选样线索，但仅靠特征稀有度无法揭示对性能关键的错误。

Method: 将模型内部特征与预测误差及其对性能的预期影响相联系，在不使用候选图像标签的前提下，选择用于标注和重训练的图像。评估方式为：在目标检测器上，使用两个数据集、两对随机种子进行实验，并将该方法与包括仅基于特征稀有度在内的六种方法比较。

Result: 加入内部特征后在16种条件中的15种提升了预测误差识别能力；在多个连续标注轮次平均性能上，该方法在四种评估设置中均优于仅基于稀有度的选择，并在六种方法中位列前二；在其他条件固定时，重训练后性能仍高于稀有度选择，尽管后者收集了更多错误；在更长重训练下，该方法在六种方法中排名第一。

Conclusion: 将模型内部特征与其误差及误差对性能的影响相关联，有助于选择能提升性能的训练图像，使模型当前状态能够指导下一步标注哪些图像。

Abstract: With limited annotation budgets, choosing which images to label determines how much a model improves. Data-selection methods that use features from a separately trained model, or scene descriptions written by vision-language models, have been successful, but those signals do not directly capture changes in the model being improved. The target model's own internal features reflect what it has learned so far and change with retraining, making them a natural cue for choosing the next training data. However, feature rarity alone does not reveal the errors that matter for performance. Here we link internal features to prediction errors and their expected impact on performance and select images for labeling and retraining without using labels for candidate images. We evaluated the method with an object detector on two datasets and two pairs of random seeds. Adding internal features improved the identification of prediction errors in 15 of 16 conditions. When performance was averaged over successive labeling rounds, the method outperformed selection based only on feature rarity in all four evaluation settings and ranked among the top two of six methods. With other conditions held fixed, performance after retraining was again higher than with rarity-based selection, even though the latter collected more errors. With longer retraining, the proposed method ranked first among six methods. These results suggest that linking a model's internal features to its errors and their effects on performance may help select training images that improve performance, thereby allowing the model's current state to guide which images are labeled next.

</details>


### [425] [How Far Are We from Removing the Visual Encoder? Scaling Laws for Encoder-Free Multimodal Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35457)
*Lin Chen,Bolin Ni,Qi Yang,Lan Jiang,Kun Ding,Xiaoran Fan,Hower Yang,Ying Wang,Shiming Xiang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文系统比较了无编码器与基于编码器的多模态大模型的缩放规律，发现随规模增大，预训练视觉编码器的优势逐渐减弱，无编码器架构具有潜力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大多数多模态大模型依赖预训练视觉编码器以提供视觉先验，而无编码器模型直接从原始像素学习视觉表示，架构更简洁统一，但其缩放行为尚未被系统刻画。本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 对比无编码器与基于编码器的多模态大模型的缩放规律，分析计算最优分配、损失-计算前沿曲线，并考察语言模型在无视觉编码器时通过视觉特定适应接管其角色的机制。

Result: （1）移除视觉编码器使多模态目标的计算最优分配转向更大模型，而文本目标几乎不变；（2）两种架构在文本目标上损失-计算前沿几乎重叠，但在多模态目标上出现分化，无编码器模型在小规模下表现较差，预计在约10^22 FLOPs时追平；（3）语言模型通过视觉特定适应接管编码器角色，视觉token间双向交互随计算增长越发有益，视觉处理前移至更早层，视觉token的专家路由更集中。

Conclusion: 预训练编码器所提供的视觉先验优势随规模增大而减弱，无编码器架构是多模态预训练的一个有前景的方向。

Abstract: Most modern multimodal large language models (MLLMs) build on a pretrained visual encoder that provides a strong visual prior. Encoder-free MLLMs instead learn visual representations directly from raw pixels, offering a simple and unified architecture, but their scaling behavior has not been systematically characterized. To fill this gap, we compare scaling laws for encoder-free and encoder-based MLLMs and report three main findings: (1) Removing the visual encoder shifts the compute-optimal allocation for the multimodal objective toward larger models, while leaving that for text nearly unchanged. (2) The two architectures exhibit nearly overlapping loss--compute frontiers on the text objective, but diverge on the multimodal objective: encoder-free models underperform at small scales yet are predicted to catch up at around $10^{22}$ FLOPs, well within practical pretraining budgets. (3) Without a visual encoder, the language model learns to take over its role via vision-specific adaptation: bidirectional interactions among visual tokens become increasingly beneficial as training compute grows, visual processing shifts toward earlier layers, and expert routing for visual tokens becomes more concentrated. Overall, our results indicate that the advantage of the visual prior provided by a pretrained encoder diminishes with scale, positioning encoder-free architectures as a promising direction for multimodal pretraining.

</details>


### [426] [W2Rep: Learning Visual Representations by Watching the World Change](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35464)
*Wen Huang,Hang Guo,Jiarui Yang,Zheng Liu,Tao Dai,Shu-tao Xia*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: W2Rep 利用视频中的场景变化来改进单图像特征，通过掩码特征预测框架同时提升图像与视频表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图像自监督学习单帧的空间结构，视频方法通常从多帧联合表示中学习时间关系。作者希望探索：观察场景变化能否在不牺牲视频表示能力的前提下，改进单图像可用的特征。

Method: 提出 W2Rep，一种掩码特征预测框架。独立编码的源图像参与同一时刻或另一时刻的预测，预测器以可见视频上下文、查询位置以及源与目标之间的带符号时间间隔为条件。该跨帧目标具有双重作用：图像路径学习跨时间仍有用的特征，视频路径则需收集源图像中缺失的证据。

Result: 在不同模型规模和下游任务上，W2Rep 在作者的比较协议下改进了冻结与微调识别性能，联合视频编码相较逐帧聚合带来进一步提升。控制实验表明，增益依赖于直接更新源图像特征，以及同时使用视频上下文和时间位移。

Conclusion: 视频中的变化可以监督视觉编码器，使其表示在图像或视频粒度上均保持有用。

Abstract: Images capture the world at one moment, whereas video reveals how it changes. Image self-supervision learns spatial structure from a single moment, while video methods commonly learn temporal relationships inside a representation computed jointly from several frames. We ask whether watching a scene change can instead improve features available from one image without sacrificing the ability to represent video. We introduce W2Rep, a masked feature-prediction framework in which an independently encoded source image participates in prediction at the same or another moment. The predictor is conditioned on visible video context, the queried location, and the signed time interval between source and target. This gives the cross-frame objective two complementary roles: the image path learns features that remain useful across time, while the video path must gather evidence that is missing from the source image. Across model scales and downstream tasks, W2Rep improves frozen and fine-tuned recognition under our comparison protocol, while joint video encoding provides further gains over frame-wise aggregation. Controlled experiments show that these gains depend on directly updating the source-image features and on using both video context and temporal displacement. Overall, change across a video can supervise a visual encoder whose representations remain useful at either image or video granularity. Code is available at~\href{https://wenooi.github.io/W2Rep}{https://wenooi.github.io/W2Rep}.

</details>


### [427] [Handwritten Text Recognition Lives in the High-Pixel Variance Subspace](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35473)
*Carlos Garrido-Munoz,Jorge Calvo-Zaragoza*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 在五语言六个手写文本识别基准上，像素重建式自监督（MIM）优于JEPA与对比式方法，因其在学习的高方差像素子空间中保留了判别信号；冻结的像素式编码器配合预训练LLM解码器可媲美全监督微调基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自然图像分类中对比式自监督常优于像素重建，但手写文本识别（HTR）呈现相反趋势。作者认为差异源于判别信号在像素空间中的分布位置：HTR的判别信息集中于高方差方向、几乎不在低方差方向，因此保留高方差像素内容的目标函数应最利于迁移。

Method: 在统一编码器、数据与评测协议下，比较三大家族共六种自监督方法：像素接地类掩码图像建模（MIM）、JEPA、以及对比式方法。评测覆盖五种语言、六个手写基准，包含全标签微调、两种冻结探测，并检验编码器表示与高方差像素子空间的对齐度与CER的关系；另以预训练LLM作解码器评估冻结编码器。

Result: 全标签下，像素接地式SSL在每个基准和两种冻结探测上CER最低，其表示已暴露逐位置字符信息（其他家族需依赖读出层才能恢复），且是唯一能从真实手写数据预训练中获益的家族；标签效率更高。各数据集上，编码器与高方差像素子空间的对齐度可在每种方法内部预测CER。搭配预训练LLM解码器时，冻结像素式编码器与全监督微调基线竞争力相当；完全微调取得最低平均CER，并在每个基准上排名一或二。

Conclusion: 像素重建式自监督的价值取决于判别信号在输入中的分布位置：当判别信号集中于高方差像素方向时（如手写文本），保留高方差像素内容的目标函数迁移最佳。该结论解释了HTR与自然图像分类间的SSL方法差异，并为HTR预训练目标选择提供了依据。

Abstract: In self-supervised pretraining for Handwritten Text Recognition (HTR), pixel reconstruction methods outperform contrastive methods, unlike in natural-image classification. We argue that this difference follows from where discriminative signal lies in pixel space: for HTR, it is concentrated in high-variance directions and largely absent from low-variance ones. This predicts that objectives preserving high-variance pixel content will transfer best. We test six SSL methods from three families (pixel-grounded MIM, JEPA, and contrastive) under matched encoder, data, and evaluation protocols on six handwriting benchmarks across five languages. With full labels, pixel-groundrounded SSL achieves the lowest CER on every benchmark and both frozen probes, exposes per-position character information that other families recover only through the readout, and is the only family to benefit from pretraining on real handwriting. Pixel-grounded representations are also more label efficient. Across datasets, encoder alignment with the high-variance pixel subspace predicts CER within every method. With a pretrained LLM decoder, a frozen pixel-grounded encoder is competitive with fully fine-tuned supervised baselines; full fine-tuning achieves the lowest mean CER and ranks first or second on every benchmark. These results show that the value of pixel reconstruction depends on where discriminative signal lies in the input.

</details>


### [428] [AHMAD: Adaptive Hybrid Multi-task Vision Learning with Assisted Distillation for Keypoint Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35490)
*Mohammad Mahdi,Nedyalko Prisadnikov,Yuqian Fu,Carmelo Scribano,Danda Pani Paudel,Luc Van Gool*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出AHMAD框架，用共享编码器-解码器加轻量任务专用投影器统一五类视觉任务，并通过知识蒸馏实现单次前向的关键点检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用多任务视觉模型需要统一稠密与稀疏预测等结构差异较大的任务，现有方法难以有效处理这种输出结构差异。同时，自顶向下关键点检测因多次前向导致计算开销高。

Method: 提出AHMAD框架，集成语义分割、实例分割、深度估计、关键点检测和目标检测五类任务；采用共享编码器-解码器加若干轻量任务专用投影器的统一结构；针对关键点检测引入基于知识蒸馏的方法，实现整图单次前向。

Result: 多任务学习范式下观察到互补性性能增益，在COCO-val全景分割上取得PQ 53.1、语义分割mIoU 66.5的最优结果；关键点检测效率大幅提升。

Conclusion: AHMAD提供了一个轻量且有效的通用多任务学习框架，在五类视觉任务上均展现强劲性能。

Abstract: Generalist multitasking vision models aim to unify multiple vision tasks within a single framework, enabling more efficient and versatile learning. However, handling diverse vision tasks -- spanning dense and sparse predictions -- remains challenging due to their inherently varying output structures. In this paper, we propose AHMAD, a simple yet effective framework for generalist multitask learning that integrates different key vision tasks: semantic segmentation, instance segmentation, depth estimation, keypoint detection, and object detection. Our approach incorporates these five tasks into a unified structure: a shared encoder-decoder with several lightweight task-specific projectors. Under the multitask learning paradigm, we observed a complementary performance gain, achieving a state-of-the-art PQ of 53.1 and an mIoU of 66.5 for COCO-val panoptic and semantic segmentation, respectively. Additionally, for top-down keypoint detection, which typically incurs high computational overhead due to multiple forward passes, we introduce a knowledge distillation-based method that enables a single forward pass over the entire image, greatly improving efficiency. Ultimately, our model delivers a lightweight yet effective generalist multitask learning framework, demonstrating strong performance across five vision tasks.

</details>


### [429] [From Scores to Samples: Elastic Forcing for Autoregressive Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35491)
*Chi Zhang,Yueyi Liu,Haoyang Shi,Ruichuan An,Haoyu Li,Yuhang Wu,Sen Cui,Miao Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种无需分数模型的多步自回归视频生成后训练框架，直接在冻结的自监督视频表征空间中以MMD匹配参考视频分布，用Nyström-蒙特卡洛混合估计器平衡偏差与方差，并以内存高效回放和梯度子采样实现实用化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 少步自回归视频生成通常依赖分布匹配蒸馏（DMD），需要双向扩散教师模型和在线伪分数模型，开销大且结构复杂。作者希望直接从参考视频学习rollout分布，从而在post-training阶段去除这两个分数模型。

Method: 在冻结的自监督视频表征空间中最小化最大均值差异（MMD），采用Nyström与蒙特卡洛混合估计器权衡近似偏差与采样方差；通过内存高效回放与梯度子采样使目标函数可实际训练。模型架构与初始化与Self-Forcing一致。

Result: 1.3B模型将VBench Total分数从83.80提升至84.64，同时保持17 FPS；去除辅助分数模型后，可在八张H200 GPU上完成14B模型的后训练。该方法还能从参考视频获取新的视觉风格、语义概念和空间先验，而无需目标专用的扩散教师。

Conclusion: 以参考视频分布匹配替代分数模型蒸馏是可行且高效的，既简化了后训练流程、提升生成质量与可扩展性，又为风格与概念迁移提供了不依赖目标专用扩散教师的途径。

Abstract: Few-step autoregressive video generation commonly relies on Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD), requiring a bidirectional diffusion teacher and an online fake-score model. We instead learn the rollout distribution directly from reference videos, eliminating both score models during post-training. Our framework minimizes maximum mean discrepancy (MMD) in frozen self-supervised video representation spaces, using a hybrid Nyström--Monte Carlo estimator to balance approximation bias and sampling variance. Memory-efficient replay and gradient subsampling make this objective practical. Using the same architecture and initialization as Self-Forcing, our 1.3B model improves the VBench Total score from 83.80 to 84.64 while retaining 17 FPS. Removing auxiliary score models also enables 14B post-training on eight H200 GPUs. Beyond distillation, learning from reference videos enables the acquisition of new visual styles, semantic concepts, and spatial priors without a target-specific diffusion teacher.

</details>


### [430] [Sprout: Building Dynamic Memory While Reasoning for Agentic Video Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35497)
*Wei Chen,Xuanyu Zheng,Yancheng Long,Haoyang Xu,Kaiyu Jiang,Bin Wen,Tingting Gao,Han Li,Long Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 Sprout，一种"边推理边构建记忆"的智能体框架，用时间树结构按问题逐步生长节点，取代传统的先离线建库再推理的流程，在保持或提升准确率的同时降低上下文开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长视频理解受限于多模态大模型的上下文长度，需依赖视频记忆。现有方法采用"先构建后推理"流程：先为整段视频离线构建记忆，再将其作为静态来源进行推理。该流程两端都有代价：当问题较少时，为整段视频构建记忆的开销远超回答问题的需要；当问题较多时，记忆从不更新，回答过程中获得的信息无法传递给下一个问题。

Method: 提出 Sprout 智能体框架，在推理中构建记忆：构建一棵随时间生长的树，随问题回答而萌发细节节点。智能体以低帧率逐段观看视频，在能回答当前问题时停止；将每个片段记为树的粗粒度节点，并以更高帧率回访关键区间，用恢复的细节精化树。片段一旦被记为文本，其视频输入即从上下文历史中移除，但原始视频仍可通过视频工具访问。记忆树与历史问答记录跨问题持久保留，使记忆在线且动态：从第一个问题开始构建，并被后续每个问题更新。

Result: 用文本记忆替代累积的视频输入可显著减少上下文占用，同时保持准确率，在部分设置下还略有提升。在三个模型的多个基准上，Sprout 相比代表性离线记忆方法取得相当或更优的准确率，且无需前置构建阶段，每个问题的上下文成本更低。

Conclusion: Sprout 通过"边推理边构建记忆"的时间树与文本化记忆机制，克服了离线记忆构建的高成本与不可更新问题，实现了在线、动态的视频记忆，在准确率与上下文效率上均具优势。

Abstract: Long video understanding relies on video memory to overcome the context limits of multimodal large language models. Existing methods follow a build-then-reasoning pipeline: memory is built offline for the entire video, then reasoned over as a static source. In practice a long video is shared by several questions, and this pipeline is costly at both ends: with few questions, building memory for the whole video costs far more than answering them; with many questions, the memory is never updated, so what is learned while answering questions is lost to the next question. To alleviate these, we introduce Sprout, an agentic framework that builds memory while reasoning: a temporal tree that sprouts detailed nodes as questions are answered. The agent watches the video segment by segment at a low frame rate, stopping when the current question can be answered, remembers each segment as a coarse node of the tree, and revisits key intervals at a higher frame rate to refine the tree with the recovered details. Once a segment is recorded as text, its video input is removed from the context history, while the original video remains reachable through the video tools. The memory tree and prior question--answer records persist across questions, so the memory is online and dynamic: built from the first question onward and updated by every question thereafter. We find that replacing accumulated video inputs with textual memory substantially reduces context usage while maintaining accuracy, with slight improvements in some settings. Across benchmarks on three models, Sprout achieves competitive or improved accuracy relative to representative offline memory methods, with no upfront construction stage and lower context cost per question.

</details>


### [431] [SolveEdit: Benchmarking Visual Problem Solving in Generative Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35504)
*Wenjie Shu,Yexin Liu,Harold Haodong Chen,Xuerui Qiu,Zehan Wang,Yidi Zhang,Yizhan Chen,Zunwei Wang,Minghao Liu,Qi Chen,Harry Yang,Xiaogang Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SolveEpIT基准，用于评估目标驱动的视觉问题求解（通过场景变换），并引入两阶段规划器SolveEdiT-PLAN以提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准主要评估感知、生成或显式指定的变换，忽略了目标驱动的视觉问题求解。现实问题（如整理物体、修复布局、规划路线）需要理解场景、推断所需变化，并在不破坏无关内容的前提下实现变化。

Method: 提出SolveEpIT基准，包含2,728个案例；采用原子过渡契约（atomic transition contracts）指定必需与保护条件，无需单一参考输出即可评估；提出SolveEdiT-PLAN，一种两阶段视觉规划器，在生成前先实例化过渡。

Result: 最强评估模型仅达到57.0%的SolveScore；在匹配的单次生成评估下，SolveEdiT-PLAN在三个测试生成器上平均提升SolveScore 9.1分，其中GPT-Image-2从57.0%提升至71.6%，且未修改编辑器。

Conclusion: 目标驱动的视觉问题求解具有挑战性；两阶段规划（先实例化过渡再生成）能有效提升性能且无需修改生成器。

Abstract: Machine intelligence is often evaluated through abstract reasoning problems, yet many real-world problems are visual, such as arranging objects, repairing layouts, or tracing routes. Solving these problems requires understanding a scene, inferring what must change to achieve a goal, and realizing that change without disturbing unrelated content. However, existing benchmarks mainly evaluate perception, generation, or explicitly specified transformations, leaving goal-driven visual problem solving underexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce SolveEpIT, a benchmark for visual problem solving through scene transformation. Given an image and a goal, a model must infer a valid transformation from the request, the scene, or a visually expressed rule, then execute it while preserving unrelated content. SoLvEEDrr contains 2,728 cases. Atomic transition contracts specify required and protected conditions, enabling SoLvEScoRE to measure completion and unintended changes without a single reference output. The strongest evaluated model achieves only57.0% SolvEScore. We further introduce SolveEdiT-PLAN, a two-stage visual planner that instantiates the transition before generation. Under matched single-generation evaluation, it improves SoLvEScoRE by 9.1 points on average across three tested generators, including a gain from 57.0% to 71.6% for GPT-Image-2, without modifying the editor.

</details>


### [432] [ReVA: A Scene-Centric Dataset Beyond Repetition for Remote Sensing Video Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35507)
*Zhen Yao,Likai Wang,Yuming Yang,Zhihao Zheng,Bo Lang,Qiuyu Tang,Jialu Sheng,Jingqi Xu,Yuehai Yang,Jumal Barker,Xiaowen Ying,Mooi Choo Chuah*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 ReVA，一个面向无人机遥感视频问答的新数据集，用于评估多模态大模型（MLLMs）的时空、场景中心与推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有遥感多模态推理基准存在两大局限：一是依赖模板生成问题，导致问题重复；二是使用静态图像，无法捕捉无人机/UAV 视频固有的时间特性。因此，遥感视频推理的系统性评估仍基本空白。

Method: 构建 ReVA 数据集，包含 2,438 段无人机视频（覆盖全球 18 个城市，共 580K 帧）以及 22K 高质量问答对，涵盖 11 项具有挑战性的 QA 任务。采用半自动标注流程，结合文本 LLM 与 MLLM 生成问答并进行人工校验。

Result: 在 ReVA 上评测了 23 个专有与开源的视频大模型，揭示了当前模型在遥感视频理解方面的根本性局限。

Conclusion: ReVA 可作为推动遥感视频理解与时间推理能力发展的关键基准，助力真实场景部署；代码与数据集已公开。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable advances in remote sensing. However, existing remote sensing multimodal reasoning benchmarks exhibit two critical limitations: they rely on (i) template-driven questions, which causes repetitive questions; and (ii) static images that fail to capture the inherent temporal nature of drone/UAV videos. This leaves systematic evaluation of remote sensing video reasoning largely unexplored.
